PLAN "12-Week Vegan Muscle Gain Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "muscle gain"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Body Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper Body Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full Body & Core":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

  PROTEIN 150g plant
  NOTES
    - All protein must be sourced from plant foods (e.g. tofu, tempeh, seitan, lentils, beans, chickpeas, edamame, quinoa, soy milk, vegan protein powder, nuts, seeds, whole grains).
    - Distribute protein intake evenly across 4-5 meals per day.
    - Include a variety of plant protein sources to ensure a complete amino acid profile.
    - Supplement with vitamin B12, vitamin D, and omega-3 (algae-based) as needed for a strict vegan diet.
    - Example meal ideas:
      - Breakfast: Oats with soy milk, chia seeds, and vegan protein powder.
      - Lunch: Lentil and quinoa salad with chickpeas and mixed greens.
      - Snack: Edamame and a handful of almonds.
      - Dinner: Tofu stir-fry with brown rice and vegetables.
      - Post-workout: Vegan protein shake with banana.
